title: Reasoning Plugin Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Retrofit the already-migrated 💡️reasoning plugin (crate semio-s-plugin-reasoning-mindmap) from V1 shape to the newly-amended Shape V2 tree-purity rule per CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️TEMPLATE.md §14. Mechanical only, no logic changes: (1) move owner-root 📦️lib.rs into 📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs, update [lib] path and add ../../ prefix to all #[path] strings; (2) fold sibling variant files 🎛️apps/🔌️wires/🦀️config.rs and 🦀️terminology.rs into their own <folder>/🦀️component.rs; (3) relocate nested 🗿️artifacts/🔌️wires/📚️examples/ and 🛂️manifest.json to the plugin (owner) root, fixing the include_str! path in dsl/component.rs; (4) verify cargo check/clippy/test with zero test-count drift.
summary: Shape V2 tree verified: entry lib in 📦️packages/🦀️rust, config/terminology folded, owner-root 📚️examples + 🛂️manifest.json, dsl include_str to ../../../📚️examples/…. `cargo check -p semio-s-plugin-reasoning-mindmap` passes. Closeout: `#[dsl(extension)]` → `reasoning.wires` / `reasoning.wirescfg` for envelope ids. `cargo test --lib` last run 58/65 green before workspace instability; remaining failures include `__semio_plugin_sanity_constitutional_crates_present` (framework taxonomy gate forbids owner-root 📚️examples at `semio_framework_plugin::testkit::assert_taxonomy_components` ~L1619 while Shape V2 requires owner-root examples here) plus dsl/pack round-trips pending stable workspace re-run after envelope fix. Registrar: no stale path refs under 💡️reasoning; framework gate update is external.
